description: Set up an existing repository from user-approved requirements without resuming an active run.

commands.usage:
usage: orchid start <requirements-file> [--verify "<command>"] [--worktree <path>] [--ack-unattended --reason "<reason>"]
       orchid start --refresh-push-guard
Use a committed repository and explicit requirements. --verify is one line and never replaces an existing committed verify command. --worktree defaults to ../<repo>-orchid. Unattended trust stays off unless both --ack-unattended and --reason are supplied. The refresh form takes no requirements or other options; it only repairs an Orchid-owned pre-push guard.

usage: orchid start help
Show setup and push-guard-maintenance reference. Equivalent to orchid start --help.
